status.summary: Retired. Former interim UFC lightweight champion who retired after losing a unanimous decision to Max Holloway at UFC 318 in Louisiana (Jul 19, 2025). In May 2026 he talked about returning for a Diaz fight, and a July 2026 French report was headlined with a '95%' remark about a return. No fight booked.
sources: data/derived/fighters.json (recent: last bout 2025-07-19 vs Max Holloway, U-DEC loss)

calf kicks (18 leg strikes landed vs Conor McGregor at UFC 257, UFC Stats)

weaknesses: submitted in both of his last two title fights: Charles Oliveira (RNC, UFC 269) and Islam Makhachev (D'Arce, UFC 302)
KO'd by a Justin Gaethje head kick (UFC 291, 2023)

style.summary: A southpaw boxer-puncher who goes looking for exchanges: 80% of his landed significant strikes go to the head and he scored knockdowns at twice the division rate. He backs his boxing with a dangerous front-headlock and guillotine game and has finished elite opponents both ways, but in his last years he took heavy damage and lost to the top grapplers and kickers of his era.
sources: data/derived/fighters.json (career and recency-weighted UFC Stats sums)

Head group leans on the southpaw left straight (cross) and hooks, as in his UFC 257, 299 and 318 bouts, which ended by punches or went the distance with 94 of 109 landed to the head vs Holloway (raw bout stats). Kicks to the head are rare; his leg work is mainly calf kicks (UFC 257: 18 leg strikes landed), so calf outweighs inside. Spinning is 0: none appears in his recent finishes. Knee and elbow are small: about 15% of his landed strikes come in the clinch (career). These weights are an analyst judgment from the bout stats above, not a published breakdown.
